subject: Action plan — legal sequencing & sign-off schedule for Zephyr POC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@zephyrhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + proposed legal/procurement sequencing for POC

Hi Jill / Zephyr procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday — appreciate the transparency on your internal milestones. Per our discussion, I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation tasks and the dependent legal/procurement milestones so we can get the POC started on time. Highlights: 

- Week-by-week POC activities for the evaluation team (data ingest, integration, SLAs to smoke-test).
- Legal gating: target dates for MSA counter-signature, DPA acceptance or narrow scoping, and order form execution.
- Procurement steps: PO issuance window and billing contact.

What I need from you to finalize:
- Confirmation whether Zephyr needs the DPA signed before the POC starts or if an interim agreement (data-handling addendum) is acceptable.
- Your internal target for PO approval (approx date).

If the MSA takes longer than 10 business days to clear legal, we have an option to run a time-limited NDA + minimal data access so the engineering ramp can begin; I've noted that in the MAP under contingency paths.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_Zephyr_v2.xlsx (MAP draft).

Would you be able to review and call out any hard blocking dates by EOD Thursday (3/4)? Happy to run through line-by-line with Lauren if needed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Zephyr_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jill Harper <jill.harper@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zephyrhealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed legal/procurement sequencing for POC

Karthik,

Thanks for sending this over — the MAP is helpful. Quick notes from procurement/security: 

- Procurement target: PO issuance by 2026-03-25. That's contingent on a signed MSA and acceptable DPA language.
- Security (Tom) flagged two DPA questions and would like to see Redwood's standard subprocessor list before we start data exchange.
- Our legal team will review the MSA redlines and send back comments by 2026-03-10; they usually take ~5 business days.

Short answer: we cannot issue a PO without at least a mutually agreed MSA (signature or DocuSign pending) and DPA positions resolved. We can, however, start non-production account provisioning if a limited DPA scope and an internal SOC-2 attestation are provided.

I'll pull in Lauren if we need language discussion. Thanks — Jill

Jill Harper
Director, Procurement
Zephyr Health
jill.harper@zephyrhealth.com

Attachments: Zephyr_DPA_Questions.pdf (question list)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@zephyrhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed legal/procurement sequencing for POC

Thanks, Jill — great context. Looping in Lauren (legal) and Grace (solutions) to align on the items below and to propose concrete actions/timing.

Lauren / Grace — summary of Zephyr asks: 
1) MSA: Zephyr will send redlines by 3/10 (they estimated ~5 business day review).
2) DPA: Tom requested subprocessor list + answers to 3 questions (see attached).
3) Procurement: PO by 3/25 contingent on MSA/DPA.

Proposed Redwood sequencing to avoid blocking the evaluation: 
- 3/04: Redwood returns a clean MSA with notes and a suggested one-week review SLA for both legal teams. (Attached: MSA-redline-20260304.docx)
- 3/05–3/12: Parallel DPA Q&A exchange; Redwood to provide subprocessor list and SOC2 snapshot by 3/06.
- 3/08: Provision non-prod access with data minimization controls if Zephyr signs an interim DPA addendum (we can draft).
- 3/22–3/25: Target window for PO + order form signature if redlines closed.

If Zephyr confirms that PO by 3/25 is firm, we will prioritize addressing legal redlines.

Karthik

--
MSA attachment: MSA-redline-20260304.docx (redline stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jill Harper <jill.harper@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed legal/procurement sequencing for POC

Jill / Karthik — quick legal note after a first pass on Zephyr's likely redlines: 

- We can accept most standard indemnity/limitation edits, but a couple of clauses (data residency and export controls) will need slightly tighter language.
- Regarding the DPA: we generally require an executed DPA before any production data flows. For the POC, we're comfortable with an interim DPA addendum that limits data types and retention; please confirm Tom is OK with that approach.
- If Zephyr needs subprocessor detail earlier, I can provide our current list and a brief SOC2 statement by EOD 3/6.

If procurement is pushing to have a signed order form + PO by 3/25, we should aim to have legal alignment by 3/17 to leave time for signature cycles.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 17:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action plan — legal sequencing & sign-off schedule for Zephyr POC

Karthik / Lauren / Grace — quick update from Zephyr legal/security.

- Our legal team intends to return redlines to your MSA by end of day 3/10 as noted. They specifically requested the clause we discussed around export controls be clarified; we've flagged examples where language could be tightened.
- Tom (security) reviewed Redwood's subprocessor list — acceptable with two follow-up questions (see attached DPA questions). If Redwood can confirm SOC2 snapshot + subprocessor controls by 3/06, we'll confirm interim DPA addendum for non-prod by 3/08.
- Procurement confirms the PO timeline remains 3/25 but asked that the order form template be provided to speed sign-off.

Next steps agreed: 
1) Lauren to send SOC2 snapshot & subprocessor list by 3/06.
2) Karthik to share our standard order form template and confirm DocuSign link once MSA is agreed.
3) Grace to provision non-prod environment upon interim DPA addendum signature.

If those deliverables land on schedule, we are set to start the POC week of 3/15 with a hard PO + order form by 3/25. If any of the legal items slip > 3 business days, procurement will need to re-evaluate the PO target.

Thanks,
Jill Harper
Director, Procurement
Zephyr Health
